entities.name: Arabidopsis VPS53B
observations: Exact 569-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt F4I7Y2; predicted mass 64.12 kDa and pI 5.86.
Component of the GARP complex; involved in retrograde transport from endosomes to late Golgi/TGN and associated membrane fusion.
Annotated localization: cytoplasm, Golgi/TGN, and endosome membranes; peripheral membrane protein.
Pfam matches: Vps53_N PF04100 at residues 3–378 and VPS53_C PF16854 at residues 397–482; no catalytic reaction retrieved.

entities.name: Endosome-to-Golgi transport
observations: VPS53B is annotated in retrograde transport from endosome to Golgi (GO:0042147).
